blocks.text: This Kundli is for educational and personal reflection purposes only.

sectionsBuilt.note: Disclaimer section is the ONLY section that has content when data is empty. This is the critical issue: a document with only a disclaimer passes the renderer but fails the integrity validator.

data.note: When bySection.get(id) returns undefined, the non-null assertion pushes undefined into sections. The renderer then tries to render undefined sections, which either skips them or produces empty pages.
